previewViewers.description: Who may open a preview deployed with no edge in front, which Identity-Aware Proxy serves: IAM members such as user:ana@example.com, group:team@example.com or domain:example.com.

project.description: The Google Cloud project to deploy into. Omit it and ocel reads GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, CLOUDSDK_CORE_PROJECT, then the credentials and gcloud config.

region.description: The region to deploy into. A project spans them all, so this names the one.
